summary: Ansible has three test types: sanity (static analysis enforcing coding standards), integration (functional tests of modules and core), and units (tests of individual code parts).
questions: What kinds of tests does ansible-test run?
What's the difference between sanity, unit and integration tests in Ansible?

answer_card.title: Types of Ansible tests
answer_card.answer_md:
- **sanity**: static code analysis that enforces coding standards.
- **integration**: functional tests of modules and ansible-core.
- **units**: tests of individual parts of the code base.
